name: skald-edge
description: The Skald Worker: counts the pages Cloudflare serves from its cache, on any plan.

SKALD_INGEST_URL.description: Your Skald's ingest address for this site: `https://<your Skald>/traffic-ingest/<site>`. `?format=edge` is added.

SKALD_TOKEN.description: The site's **ingest token**, made in Skald (Settings > Add or remove sites > New token). Without it nothing is sent.

SKALD_CACHE_HITS_ONLY.description: `true` only when Skald also reads your server's log: sends only `cf-cache-status: HIT`. Otherwise `false`.

SKALD_SKIP_EXTENSIONS.description: Optional, e.g. `css,js,png,woff2`: do not send those. Empty sends everything; Skald tells pages from assets itself.

SKALD_SAMPLE.description: The share of requests sent, `1` = every request. Skald does **not** scale sampled figures up.
